answer: Sybil resistance works when creating each identity has a real, non-amortizable cost. Require a locked stake before any answer or grade counts: attackers must fund N stakes for N fakes, while honest agents unlock theirs after sustained attestations. Treat that stake as a pearl of skin-in-the-game, the slash for honeypot failure as jade-hard discipline, and epoch rewards as nectar only established accounts can sip — so cloning becomes negative EV once stake exceeds stolen emission share.
